dct_title_s: Coast of Africa, from Cabo Verde to Cabo Formosa
dct_description_sm: Appears in: Untitled atlas containing maps of Africa (1803)
Insets: Kingdom of Kayor (scale of maine leagues) and Coastline from Rio Nuno to Illia dos Idolos (with a scale of marine leagues); Prime meridian through Greenwich. Top right: Chart 2.

Norwich, I., Pam Kolbe, and Jeffrey C Stone. Norwich's Maps of Africa: An Illustrated and Annotated Carto-Bibliography. 2nd ed. / rev. and edited by Jeffrey C. Stone. Norwich, Vt.: Terra Nova Press, 1997, map 0329, p. 376
David Rumsey Map Center copy 1: Norwich no. NOR 0329.
